Follow any news source, YouTube channel, or podcast. AI reads, summarises, and prioritises everything — so you get the signal without the noise.

### News Feed

Follow any publication via RSS. AI reads your entire feed daily and delivers a sourced briefing — the most important stories in under a minute. A personalised For You feed learns what matters to you and ranks it accordingly.

### YouTube

Subscribe to any channel and browse their videos in one feed. Every video gets an AI summary, full transcript, and Ask AI tab — so you can understand a video before watching it, or ask questions about it without rewatching.

### Podcasts

Follow any podcast feed. Every episode gets an AI-generated summary and interactive mind map so you know what's covered before you press play. Automatic resume picks up exactly where you left off, across sessions.

### Every angle. One briefing.

When 3+ independent sources cover the same story, AI merges them into a single sourced briefing — so you get the full picture without 10 tabs.
